انتقشوا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَقَشُوا (intaqašū) /in.ta.qa.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# اُنْتُقِشُوا (untuqišū) /un.tu.qi.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# اِنْتَقِشُوا (intaqišū) /in.ta.qi.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
